parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.lead: A sinusoidal alternating voltage has a root-mean-square (r.m.s.) potential difference (p.d.) of 4.2V and a frequency of 50 kHz.
parts.text:
The alternating voltage is applied across a resistor of resistance 760 Ω.

By considering the peak voltage, show that the maximum power dissipated by the resistor is 46mW.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
On Fig. 7.1, draw a smooth curve to show how the power *P* dissipated in the resistor varies with time *t* between *t* = 0 and *t* = 40 μs. Assume that *P* = 0 when *t* = 0.

[[fig:f1]]

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Use your line in (a)(ii) to explain why the mean power dissipated in the resistor is 23mW.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead: The alternating voltage in (a) is now applied to a piezoelectric crystal in air.
parts.text: Explain what happens to the air surrounding the crystal.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
A second piezoelectric crystal is placed in the air near to the first crystal.

Explain the effect of the surrounding air in (b)(i) on the second crystal.
